notes: Genesis 2:1-3, the completion-and-rest coda: SYN·Ground (the whole finished), SYN·Figure (the work finished), NUL·Figure (the ceasing from work), REC·Figure (blessing as generated interpretive standing) and DEF·Figure (hallowing as the boundary of the holy). The two אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה relatives are formulaic restatements of makings already asserted at chapter scale — folded (R1, noted).

rows.subject: הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ וְכָל צְבָאָֽם
rows.because: וַיְכֻלּוּ (were FINISHED) — the whole world-field and all its host brought to completion as ONE closed whole: Generate·Structure at GROUND grain; the passive states the totality's own closure

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִים֙
rows.because: וַיְכַל (finished) — ONE work completed into a whole: Generate·Structure at figure grain; 'בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי' is a temporal adjunct (A2) and the formulaic relative 'אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה' folds (R1)

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִים֙
rows.because: וַיִּשְׁבֹּת (ceased/rested) — the CESSATION of one identified activity: the working's absence begun, and the absence IS the act (A4's family) at figure grain, polarity +
rows.resolution: the verb's subject carries from וַיְכַל's אֱלֹהִים

alternate.because: readable as the re-zero into rest — the sabbath as a new ground begun

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִים֙
rows.because: וַיְבָרֶךְ (blessed) GENERATES an interpretive standing — blessedness — upon one identified day: Generate·Interpretation at figure grain, the same cell-arithmetic as the UDHR's promote-respect and secure-recognition rows (fostering/creating a standing of regard); performative, not a report of a held view

alternate.because: readable as a bounded standing assigned, the proclaims-as family

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִים֙
rows.because: וַיְקַדֵּשׁ (hallowed) — holiness is SET-APARTNESS: the day's standing bounded off from the ordinary six, Differentiate·Interpretation at figure grain

alternate.because: readable as the cut itself rather than the boundary of meaning

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִים֙
rows.because: the reason clause (כִּי, for-on-it-he-rested) restates the ceasing — a second row on gen:god-rested (R9's multi-row rule); the closing relative 'אֲשֶׁר בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת' is formulaic and folds (R1)
rows.resolution: 'בוֹ' → the seventh day; subject carries from the matrix
